stem: Under RA 9729, the Climate Change Act of 2009, who serves as the Chairperson of the Climate Change Commission?
choices: The Secretary of Environment and Natural Resources
The Vice President of the Philippines
The Secretary of Science and Technology
hints: The Commission is attached to the Office of the President and is the government's lead policy-making body on climate change.
Section 5 says who makes up the Commission: a Chairperson and three Commissioners.
Section 5 says the three Commissioners are "appointed by" the same official who chairs the Commission. Find that official among the choices.

solution.methodName: Name who is responsible, then check the exact role

steps.action: Recall Section 5 of RA 9729, as amended by RA 10174: the Commission is composed of the President of the Republic of the Philippines, "who shall serve as the Chairperson," and three Commissioners appointed by the President.
steps.why: Section 4 says the Commission is "attached to the Office of the President," so it makes sense that the President heads it.

steps.action: Note the other roles: one of the three Commissioners is appointed Vice Chairperson, and department secretaries such as those of the DENR and DOST sit on the advisory board.
The answer is the President of the Philippines.

trapNotes.The Secretary of Environment and Natural: The DENR Secretary is a member of the Commission's advisory board, not its Chairperson.
trapNotes.The Vice President of the Philippines: The Vice President is not named in Section 5. The Vice Chairperson is one of the three Commissioners.
trapNotes.The Secretary of Science and Technology: The DOST Secretary is a member of the advisory board, not the Chairperson.

sourceRef.citation: RA 9729 (Climate Change Act of 2009), Sections 4 and 5, as amended by RA 10174
